# JsonProvider — User Guide

**Important note!** This documentation was generated by an AI tool based on the codebase. Please treat the descriptions here with caution! Any translations of the documentation are also AI-generated, unless community input was involved.

JsonProvider is a self-contained PHP data provider that operates on a directory of NDJSON files as if it were a small relational database.

This document is the working reference for an engineer integrating JsonProvider into a PHP project. It covers contracts, public APIs, expected behaviour and operational topics. Internal mechanics are described only when needed to explain visible behaviour.

> Experimental note: this provider was built end-to-end via Claude Code under human guidance, as part of an experiment to develop a working software module purely through guided AI.
